description: This file defines the IQueueCacheCursor interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which provides methods for enumerating and managing a stream's messages in a queue cache, including retrieving current messages, moving to the next message, refreshing the cache, and recording delivery failures.

classes.name: IQueueCacheCursor
classes.description: Interface for a queue cache cursor that enumerates stream messages and manages cache state.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current batch container in the stream; provides exception info if presentation has completed or error occurred.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the stream, returning true if more messages exist.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cache cursor based on a provided stream sequence token.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Records a failure in delivery of the current event.
